title: Reader Errors Held-out
intro: 39 letters on the 666 held-out test lines where our reader disagrees with the current truth. Per card: the full line with the letter outlined in red, the word at 3×, the letter at 8×; Google’s word, the truth word and our reader’s word, with the marks each gives this letter. The tag says where the truth came from. “Printed” is prefilled with the current truth: correct it if the print shows something else. No note = the truth is right.

groups.heading: Google errors the reader left unfixed (14)
False mark: the reader names a mark where the truth has none (13)
Missed mark: the truth has a mark, the reader none (2)
Misnamed: both have a mark, different names (10)
